title: Pretty but difficult to hang on wall
text: Pretty but difficult to hang on wall. Pretty but there’s nothing on the back of wood to be able to hang this plaque on the wall. It’s not really heavy but once you figure out a way to put it on the wall, it won’t stay flat on the wall. It looks not so great on the wall.

product_metadata.title: Deco 79 Wood Floral Handmade Intricately Carved Wall Decor with Mandala Design, Set of 3 48"H, 48"W, Beige
features: A classic and timeless style of design for your traditional setting home
This item is made of a solid MDF wood frame and structure
This 3 panel medallion wall decor highlights a faintly distressed beige finish that enhances textured look

Intricate, ornate hand-carved flowers and acanthus designs throughout the wood-like MDF panels with a soft eggshell paint with a distressed finish, large blooming flower encompassed by a circle in the center
Large wall decor panels measure 16”L x 1”W x 48”H each and collectively weigh 28.6 lbs.
description: Crafted in India, these extra-large, breathtaking wood wall decor panels are comprised of 3 long wood panels, each with hand-carved floral and acanthus designs with a distressed eggshell white finish. The intricate carvings have dimensional details within each petal, leaf, and stem, but when hung next to each other, the three carved wall panels form a large flower encompassed by a circle, creating a dramatic natural and traditional decor piece. The finish is a distressed eggshell white paint over the MDF, adding a bright touch to your space. Easy to hang by metal hardware in back. Suitable for indoor use only. This set includes 3 panel wall decor. This item comes shipped in one carton.
